trainer_contract.architecture: Latent/one-hot labels projected through two linear layers and two transposed convolutions with tanh; discriminator has two convolutions and two linear layers. No batch normalization.
trainer_contract.image_support: Same uint8 2D 1/3-channel image layouts as image VAE; scale to [-1,1].
trainer_contract.tasks: Generation and class balancing/augmentation only; no encoder or representation learning.
trainer_contract.likelihood: Implicit; no likelihood, reconstruction loss or ELBO is computed.
trainer_contract.optimizer: Separate Adam optimizers, both use plan learning_rate, betas (0.5,0.999); gradient norm clipping 10; float32. Overrides VAE defaults.
trainer_contract.training: One discriminator update with detached fake samples followed by one non-saturating generator update with discriminator parameters frozen; stable BCE-with-logits losses.
trainer_contract.conditioning: Optional one-hot labels in generator input and spatial label channels in discriminator. Fake training labels match each real batch; final generation cycles evenly across observed training classes.
trainer_contract.generation: Standard-normal latent passed through generator, tanh rescaled/rounded to uint8; no extra observation noise or decoder means.
trainer_contract.validation: Checkpoint/early stopping minimizes pooled-image feature Wasserstein distance on fixed up-to-512 training and validation subsets. Scaler fits training only; fixed latent draws match validation labels. Average aggregate discrepancy and per-class discrepancies when conditional. Same validation score each epoch, not adversarial loss or ELBO; not FID or proof of usefulness.

limitations: Adversarial losses and pooled-feature checkpoint selection do not establish fidelity or downstream utility.
Validation is reused for checkpoint selection; final testing remains reserved.
GAN instability and mode collapse require independent quality/diversity checks.
